findings.highlight: I’m intensely aware of her femininity
findings.evidenceJa: 首に伸ばされた指と、もう目の前にある女の体
findings.governingReading: the fingers reaching around his neck and the woman’s body already before his eyes force themselves into view
findings.explanation: Concrete visual and bodily staging is replaced by an abstract awareness of femininity.

findings.highlight: You need only look at her eyes to see that
findings.evidenceJa: とろんとした目で俺を見ているのが何よりの証拠だ
findings.governingReading: her looking at him with languid, unfocused eyes is the clearest proof
findings.explanation: The specific drowsy quality of Sakura’s gaze is omitted from the evidence that she is half-asleep.

findings.highlight: I have to shake her off me
findings.evidenceJa: こんなのはすぐに振りほどいて
findings.governingReading: he must immediately disentangle himself from this
findings.explanation: The object of disengagement shifts from the situation or hold to Sakura herself, making Shirou’s response more personally forceful.

findings.highlight: her breasts are pushing up her shirt
findings.evidenceJa: 大きく張り詰めた胸元
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents pressure against a shirt and makes the description more mechanically explicit.

findings.evidenceJa: 知らないうちに成長した体
findings.governingReading: a body that had grown without him noticing
findings.explanation: The mature body remains, but Shirou’s realization that Sakura grew without his noticing disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: そんなつまらない良識
findings.governingReading: such trivial good sense or moral restraint
findings.explanation: mirror moon mistranslates moral judgment as plural sensory faculties.

findings.highlight: The sound of the pounding heart
findings.evidenceJa: 痛いとさえ思える心音
findings.governingReading: a heartbeat so forceful it seems painful
findings.explanation: The near-painful intensity of Shirou’s heartbeat is omitted.

findings.highlight: land on top of the table
findings.evidenceJa: 油断なくテーブルの上に着地する
findings.governingReading: lands on the table without letting his guard down
findings.explanation: The mock-combat vigilance that completes the exaggerated leap joke disappears.

findings.governingReading: he was badly flustered or thrown into confusion
findings.explanation: Shirou’s loss of composure is reduced to mild surprise.

findings.evidenceJa: 伸ばしていた両手をぱたんと床に落として
findings.governingReading: both outstretched arms drop to the floor with a soft flop
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces an active, audible fall of both arms with a static passive posture.

findings.highlight: I would kill myself out of shame
findings.evidenceJa: 申し訳なくて腹を切ってた
findings.governingReading: he would feel so guilty or apologetic that he would cut his belly
findings.explanation: Concern over wronging a half-asleep Sakura becomes self-directed shame.
